adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration builds raw SQL with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. The interpolated `h` comes from the old `site_settings` value (`val.split("\n")`), which is free-text admin-configurable. If any line contains a single quote, the SQL becomes invalid and can crash the migration (and it is also unsafe SQL construction). Additionally, `split("\n")` will include blank lines as `""`, and the code does not filter them, so it can insert rows with `host = ''` even though such hosts can never match and would violate the model’s format validation (though migrations bypass validations).
